newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest first-tier stocks drive turnover up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest first-tier stocks drive turnover up.

text.p: First-tier stocks Azomures and Oltchim, traded in heavy volumes on Tuesday, led turnover on the Bucharest bourse 1.0 billion lei higher to 2.2 billion.
Two independent indices rose to year highs.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker took 52 percent of the session's turnover and closed almost unchanged at 1,630 lei.
Traders said an exchange move to allow reference prices to float within a plus/minus 50 percent corridor tested on Azomures on Tuesday did not affect its price.
"Supply and demand for the stock were well-balanced and its average price stayed almost flat," said a trader.

The average price is a weighted average of all the prices at which deals are made for a particular stock. It becomes the reference price for the next session. So far, it was allowed to fluctuate within a plus/minus 10 percent margin.
Chemical plant Oltchim SA followed in Azomures' footsteps with heavy volumes. It had 921.4 million lei in turnover but closed 20 lei weaker at 1,630.
Brokers said selling pressure on Oltchim was high. "There were large packages on sale, with no matching bids," said one.
A couple of other stocks -- Artrom SA engineering company and carbide producer Carbid-Fox SA -- managed to absorb some investor interest.
Artrom had 25.9 million lei in turnover and closed 100 lei down at 3,800, and Carbid scored a turnover level of 35.6 million, gaining 90 lei to close at 1,860.
Almost all prices rose in low supply.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- climbed to year highs, going up by 2.2 and respectively 3.38 percent from the previous session.
